controls.statement: ActaSeal never holds a production signing key; the deployment operator is responsible for custody of whatever key is registered as active (KMS/HSM/offline).
ActaSeal provides the mechanism to record an audit-trail review (who reviewed, what window); deciding who reviews and how often is the operator's own control.
Retention duration is DATA the operator selects via a FrameworkProfile (or leaves undetermined); ActaSeal does not hardcode a retention period.
Which RFC 3161 timestamp authorities are trusted is a caller-supplied pool; ActaSeal does not ship or hardcode a fixed TSA set the operator is bound to.

Which role is required to approve a given policy decision is operator-set policy data (ApprovalRule.required_role); ActaSeal enforces a mismatch (APPROVER_ROLE_MISMATCH) but does not choose or hardcode who holds that role.

Whether network-touching components (S3 Object Lock anchor, Rekor, RFC 3161 TSA pool, WorkOS/Logto SSO, SMTP/Resend email) are enabled is the operator's own ACTASEAL_AIRGAPPED choice; ActaSeal refuses each by name rather than silently degrading when air-gapped mode is set.
controls.verified_from: actaseal.airgap.guard_network_component, called from actaseal.anchor.tsa / actaseal.config.email_backend / actaseal.config.workos_auth

not_covered: Does not independently verify that the running deployment is actually executing the code this bundle describes -- it describes the code as introspected/measured at bundle-build time, not a live runtime attestation of the process producing it.

Does not independently verify SBOM completeness or accuracy -- the SBOM, when present, is whatever CI's own generation step produced; this bundle only embeds and hashes it, never regenerates or audits it.

Does not attest anything about the buyer's own infrastructure, network posture, or how they operate the deployment -- the CUEC section names exactly which controls are the buyer's, not whether the buyer is actually exercising them.

The CUEC declaration only ever grows to controls this module's own code-derivation checks can currently verify; a control this module does not yet check for is not proof the boundary doesn't exist, only that this bundle does not yet claim it.

Drill receipts embedded here are accepted as already-produced input, not re-run at bundle-build time -- a stale drill receipt (old invoked_at) is embedded as-is; this bundle does not itself judge drill freshness.
No FDA/SOC2/ISO/PCAOB or any other third-party certification, clearance, or review of any kind is claimed for this bundle or the tool that produced it.
